description: File operations: delete (a file or an EMPTY folder), mkdir, rename (move within the volume: path -> to), copy (path -> to, folders recursively; on GIGA/Opta also between volumes with to_vol). The controller refuses to delete slot_0, the boot scene slot or a slot a button/timer refers to. System files need MYIO_WRITE=admin. Editor/admin level.

vol.description: q = internal flash (GIGA/Opta default), s = SD card (the only volume on a Due)

name: myio_file_op
title: Delete / rename / copy files
